title: UI and UX with Impeccable, Emil Kowalski's skill and Agentation
author: pratos with Claude Code
summary: The plan page and sessions panel work but read as a wireframe. This stage gives them one component language from the theme tokens, a top bar that names you, and clear empty and decided states. The process is the lesson: Impeccable critiques, Emil's `animate` decides motion, Agentation carries notes.
current: cp-06 ends with the plan page (threads ending in decisions), sessions in a chat panel beside it, and `just agent-serve` answering through pi-durable. The screens use grey Tailwind defaults, the top bar always says Sign in, and the `as` field starts as `pratos` whoever signed in.
discoveries: `apps/web/src/styles.css` already defines light and dark tokens (`--sea-ink`, `--lagoon`, `--surface`, `--line`); classes built on them hold in both themes.
`PRODUCT.md` and `DESIGN.md` describe the workshop deck, not the app; the critique works from the app's tokens.
Agentation mounts in `DevTools.tsx` behind `import.meta.env.DEV`, and `.mcp.json` runs `agentation-mcp`, so notes reach the agent.
The warn tone `#b45309` reads 3.7:1 on the dark background, under AA for small text: a good first note.
A Sign out in the top bar makes two on `/`; `signOut` in `e2e/helpers.ts` must scope to `header-account`.
endState: `/plans/gh-12` in dark mode, before and after: cards, one lagoon action per form, pills for counts and live, bubbles that settle in once. The top bar names you; acting as starts as you. One Agentation note fixed live.
notDoing: A new palette or font; the tokens and Manrope stay.
Showing failed runs; the bubble is styled here, `RunFailed` arrives in cp-08.
Motion on refresh, hover lists or the top bar; arrival only.
A mobile layout beyond the one-column fallback under `lg`.
approach: Critique first, on the running cp-06 page, so findings set the work. Then classes, which every screen uses; then the top bar, which changes behaviour; then page and panel. Agentation notes close it.

spec.question: How does a note on the page reach the agent and come back fixed?
spec.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Y as You
  participant T as Agentation toolbar
  participant M as agentation MCP
  participant A as Your agent
  participant C as Code
  Y->>T: pin a note on the failed bubble
  T->>M: the note, element path and classes
  A->>M: get pending, acknowledge
  A->>C: find gh-bubble-failed, fix it
  A->>M: resolve, with a summary
  M->>T: the note disappears

steps.caption: You pin a note on the element that looks wrong.
The toolbar sends it with the element path and CSS classes.
Your agent picks it up and acknowledges it first.
It greps for the class and fixes the code.
It resolves the note with what it changed.
The note leaves the page; the fix is in the diff.

decisions.question: Animate new messages?

options.label: Yes, once, on arrival: 180ms opacity and a 4px lift
No motion; a new message just appears

decisions.why: Emil's frequency gate: messages arrive a few times an hour, so a 180ms settle helps the eye find what is new. Replayed on every refresh it is noise. Off under reduced motion.
